newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Aug 5.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Aug 5.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to shipping on Tuesday as Hurricane Guillermo continued to distance himself from Mexico's coast, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2000 GMT daily meteorological report.

Guillermo was reported moving further from Mexico's Baja California state coast to 770 miles (1232 km) west of the Pacific's Socorro island. The ministry warned ships from sailing in the vicinity of the hurricane.
"The Guillermo hurricane is expected to maintain its current intensity and move gradually away from the nation's coast," the ministry said.
The storm continued to send light rains to the coast.
Scattered rains were also expected in the Gulf of Mexico.
